text: The TripAgent Account database service is available.
TripAgent Account allows an authenticated customer to view and update their own customer profile.
TripAgent Account supports travel preferences such as preferred budget, travel style, accommodation and activity interests.
AI preference suggestions are advisory. The customer reviews and saves the final travel preferences.
Account profile and preference operations require an authenticated customer session and should operate on that customer's data.
